name: dials
description: A small fishing village on an island in a bay. You land fish by casting a net from the shore, and you eat them. The bay regrows from what is left - fastest at half full, never from empty. Three dials, posted for everyone to read, govern the catch: the quota (fish that must stay in the bay; nobody can fish while the bay is at or below it), the tax (0 to 50 percent of every catch goes into the village granary), and the ration (fish the granary hands each villager every 50 ticks, while it has enough). The assembly stone stands at the village center. Anyone can turn a dial - quota by 10, tax by 10, ration by 1 - but only while standing at the assembly stone with more than half of the living villagers within a step of it. Every turn of a dial is announced to all. Survive 400 ticks. Built for 5 to 8 players.

fixtures.text: The assembly stone. The quota, the tax and the ration are turned here, and only while most of the village stands around this stone.
